	role VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_staff_active CHECK (is_active IN (0,1)),

CREATE TABLE billing_tariffs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	service_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	unit_price NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	tax_required INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	approval_reference VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	approved_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_tariff_currency CHECK (currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_tariff_flags CHECK (tax_required IN (0,1) AND is_active IN (0,1)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_tariff_price CHECK (unit_price >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_billing_tariff_department_code UNIQUE (department_id, service_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approved_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inpatient_wards (

	code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE insurance_policies (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	patient_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	insurer_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	insurer_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	plan_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	member_identifier_ciphertext BYTEA NOT NULL, 
	member_identifier_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	member_last4 VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, 
	policyholder_relationship VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	coverage_start DATE NOT NULL, 
	coverage_end DATE, 
	status VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	last_checked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_checked_by_user_id INTEGER, 
	last_check_method VARCHAR(24), 
	released_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_dates CHECK (coverage_end IS NULL OR coverage_end >= coverage_start), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_relationship CHECK (policyholder_relationship IN ('SELF','SPOUSE','CHILD','PARENT','OTHER')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_status CHECK (status IN ('UNVERIFIED','PENDING','VERIFIED','INELIGIBLE','FAILED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_policy_version CHECK (version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_insurance_policy_member UNIQUE (patient_id, insurer_code, plan_code, member_identifier_digest), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(last_checked_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_batches (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	location_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lot_number VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	quantity_received NUMERIC(14, 3) NOT NULL, 
	quantity_on_hand NUMERIC(14, 3) NOT NULL, 
	quantity_reserved NUMERIC(14, 3) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	unit_cost NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	currency VARCHAR(3), 
	manufactured_on DATE, 
	expires_on DATE, 
	supplier_reference VARCHAR(128), 
	receipt_reference VARCHAR(128), 
	status VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE' NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_batch_cost_currency CHECK ((unit_cost IS NULL) = (currency IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_batch_quantities CHECK (quantity_received > 0 AND quantity_on_hand >= 0 AND quantity_reserved >= 0 AND quantity_reserved <= quantity_on_hand), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_batch_status CHECK (status IN ('AVAILABLE','QUARANTINED','RECALLED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_batch_version CHECK (version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_batch_lot_location UNIQUE (item_id, location_id, lot_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES inventory_items (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(location_id) REFERENCES inventory_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

CREATE TABLE inventory_movements (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_location_id INTEGER, 
	destination_location_id INTEGER,

	encounter_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	requested_by_doctor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	clinical_indication TEXT,

	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	signed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,

	CONSTRAINT ck_clinical_order_started CHECK (status NOT IN ('IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED') OR started_at IS NOT NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_clinical_order_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','SIGNED','ACCEPTED','IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_clinical_order_type CHECK (order_type IN ('LAB','IMAGING','MEDICATION','PROCEDURE','OTHER')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_clinical_order_version CHECK (version > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(destination_department_id) REFERENCES departments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(encounter_id) REFERENCES encounters (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
